# celfunc — Copilot Instructions

## What this package is

`celfunc` is a proprietary internal R package for Celon Pharma S.A. It provides small utility functions for PK/PD data wrangling, formatting, and list traversal used across CPL'36 clinical trial analyses.

## Install / load

```r
# Install from local path (run once after cloning / pulling)
devtools::install("C:/Users/rjazwiec/OneDrive - CELON PHARMA/R/celfunc")

# Load in analysis scripts
library(celfunc)
```

## Run tests

```r
# Full suite
devtools::test()

# Single test file
testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-pct_print.R")
```

## Regenerate documentation / NAMESPACE

```r
devtools::document()   # runs roxygen2; do NOT edit NAMESPACE by hand
```

## Package structure

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `R/` | Exported functions — one file per functional group |
| `man/` | Auto-generated `.Rd` files — never edit manually |
| `tests/testthat/` | testthat edition 3 tests — one file per `R/` source file |
| `todo/` | Candidate functions not yet promoted to the package |
| `NAMESPACE` | Auto-generated by roxygen2 — never edit manually |

## Exported functions

### Formatting

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `pct_print(val, all, ...)` | Format a percentage from count + total |
| `pct_print2(pct, ...)` | Format a pre-computed proportion/percentage; handles `NA` via `na_token` |
| `prt(val, digits)` | Round + trim whitespace — for table cells |
| `pv_prt(val, digits, pref)` | Format p-value with `"< threshold"` notation |

### Data wrangling

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `rotate_df(df, rowname_col)` | Transpose a data frame; all columns become `character` |
| `merge_suffix_columns(df)` | Coalesce `.x`/`.y` pairs after a `dplyr` join; prefers `.x`, falls back to `.y` |
| `get_list_names(x)` | Recursively enumerate all paths in a nested list (`$` for named, `[[i]]` for unnamed) |
| `date_string(dt, fmt)` | Compact timestamp string for file names; default `"YYMMDD_HHMM"` |

### Statistical / PK

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `geom_mean(x)` | Geometric mean; returns `NA` for any non-positive value |
| `geom_mean_sup(x, sup_val)` | Geometric mean with zero substitution (BLQ-safe) |
| `geom_mean_paired(x, y)` | Geometric mean of `x` restricted to subjects with complete `(x, y)` pairs |
| `means_long(values, group, is_complete, id_col, ...)` | Geometric or arithmetic mean inside `summarise()` pipelines; supports paired restriction |
| `paired_median(values, group, is_complete, id_col, ...)` | Median with the same paired/complete-case logic as `means_long()` |
| `geom_mean_r(x, y)` | GMR = GM(y)/GM(x) via Welch's t-test; returns list with `$GMR`, `$CI`, `$p_val` |
| `calc_auc(conc, time)` | Linear trapezoidal AUC; `units`-class vectors produce a `units`-class result |

### Units utilities

| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `save_units_in_df(df)` | Snapshot `units`-class column metadata to a two-column data frame |
| `apply_units_from_df(df, units_spec)` | Restore units from a `save_units_in_df()` snapshot; missing columns silently skipped |

## Key conventions

- **Always use `%>%` (magrittr pipe)**, never the native `|>` pipe.
- **All documentation is in roxygen2 markdown** (`#'` blocks above functions). After any doc change run `devtools::document()`.
- **`NA` handling in formatting functions**: `pct_print2` replaces `NA` *after* `format()` to avoid matching the string `"NA"` — preserve this pattern in new formatting functions.
- **`rotate_df` coerces everything to `character`** via `base::t()`. Callers must not expect numeric output.
- **`units` round-trip**: `save_units_in_df` uses `deparse_unit()` to snapshot unit strings. `deparse_unit()` normalizes `"ng/mL"` → `"ng mL-1"` (udunits2 canonical). Tests must compare normalized strings, not input literals.
- **`calc_auc` is units-aware**: when both `conc` and `time` carry `units`-class attributes the result carries the product unit; otherwise a plain numeric is returned.
- **`.build_analysis_df` is an internal helper** (prefixed `.`): not exported, shared by `means_long()` and `paired_median()`.
- **`merge_suffix_columns` only touches paired columns** — an unpaired `.x`-only or `.y`-only column is left untouched by design.
- **Test file naming**: `test-<source-file-stem>.R` maps 1-to-1 with `R/<source-file-stem>.R`.
- **No `1:n` loops** — use `seq_len(n)` to handle zero-length edge cases safely (see `apply_units_from_df`).
